observations: Stack of four black Sony PlayStation 4 Pro consoles.
Two red DualShock 4 controllers in retail packaging.
The consoles are stacked on top of each other.
A watermark 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' is visible across the center of the image.
A power outlet with two black plugs is visible in the background.
The text 'SONY' is visible on the front of the top console.

claims.evidence: The consoles are stacked, hiding the condition of the sides and rear ports.
Origin and usage history cannot be determined from photos.
No games are visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The consoles may be non-functional or have internal hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the consoles booting to the home screen and running a game.

risks.risk: The consoles may be 'ghost' units (used for testing) or have a 'ghost' disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing a game disc being inserted and the console reading it.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty disc drive

risks.risk: The consoles may be missing the original retail packaging.
risks.proof: A photo of the retail box for one of the consoles.

proof_requests: Video of the consoles powering on and running a game.
Photo of the retail box for one of the consoles.
Photo of the back of the consoles to check for ports and labels.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
